description: Eswatini - Building Footprint is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Demographics", published or maintained by Min Jaegal (World Bank Group). This Building dataset includes the polygon describing its footprint on the ground, a confidence score, and the area of the polygon. Residential buildings are identified using only polygons with a confidence level above 0.7, and roof area between 37-145 m2 to get to the closest value as provided by the census data. Coverage: Eswatini. It has 1 file in ZIP. The portal files it under Demographics. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence (terms as labelled in the catalogue, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
